**Finding submitted: deviation (Section 11.1.1.4 — Trial Data Package).**

- **Favourable, left alone:** PB retains all Existing PB IP (11.1.1.1) and is sole owner of all Trial Inventions with a present assignment from SFJ and contractor/CRO/Site flow-downs (11.1.1.3, 2.4.1, 2.4.2, 3.2.1.3); SFJ gets no implied licence (11.1.1.6). PII provisions are mutual and even bar transfer of Personally Identifiable Information between the parties.
- **The problem:** SFJ is sole and exclusive owner of the Trial Data Package — defined to include all trial Information generated by or on behalf of *either* Party, i.e. our own clinical data — and PB only gets it by paying the Approval Payments plus a further redacted amount. No interim licence or use right exists anywhere; "deemed PB Confidential Information" gives no right to exploit. That fails the fallback (no perpetual, royalty-free licence) and edges into walk-away territory (our data sitting with the counterparty).
- **Redline (validated, fallback level):** new 11.1.1.4(a) granting PB a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, sublicensable licence to use and exploit the Trial Data Package and Research Results pending transfer, surviving termination — leaving SFJ's ownership/purchase-payment security structure intact.
